English: A guest? Welcome, welcome. ##<<The man flares his nostrils as he looks you up and down.>>
Chinese: 有客?欢迎,欢迎。 ##<<男人上下打量你,鼻孔微张。>>

English: I'd offer you a seat, but... these chairs are terribly expensive. I presume you are here about the job offering?
Chinese: 我本想请你坐,但……这些椅子贵得吓人。我猜你是为那份差事来的?

English: I'm here for the job.
Chinese: 我是来接活的。

English: Yes, yes - I thought as much. Your attire is certainly suited for the... physical labour of the task. ##<<He dabs his forehead with a handkerchief, as if the thought of your attire is overbearing.>>
Chinese: 对,对——我就猜是这样。你这身行头倒是挺适合这差事的……体力活。 ##<<他用手帕轻按额头,仿佛你这身行头让他不堪重负。>>

English: What job is that?
Chinese: 什么差事?

English: You mean... you simply came to exchange pleasantries?##<<He swallows, clearly repulsed at the thought.>>
Chinese: 你是说……你只是来寒暄的? ##<<他咽了口唾沫,显然被这想法恶心到了。>>

English: Tell me about yourself.
Chinese: 介绍一下你自己吧。

English: Myself? Well, I am sure you have already heard a great deal. I am Vernon Berwig, of the Winged Merchants Guild. Peruse the shops in Hallow and there is not a single potion or herb that has not graced my vessels on its way here.
Chinese: 我自己?嗯,我相信你已经如雷贯耳。我是飞翼商会的弗农·伯维格。去哈洛的店铺随便看看,没有一瓶药剂、一味草药,不是经由我的船队运抵此地。

English: Actually, I'll just be going.
Chinese: 其实,我先走了。

English: The job is to locate my merchant vessel - the [[Golden Typhos]] - and retrieve its ((cargo)).##It is a magnificent ship, made with the strongest Lundel oak; so I cannot imagine that it could have been shipwrecked.
Chinese: 差事是找到我的商船——[[黄金蒂福斯号]]——并取回它的((货物))。 ##那是一艘壮丽的船,用最坚实的伦德尔橡木建造;我无法想象它会失事。

English: It's captain is none other than [[Walter Cecil]], who has charted many of the Apostatic Union's most distant islands and is known for his character.##Mutiny, then, is not a possibility.
Chinese: 它的船长不是别人,正是[[沃尔特·塞西尔]]——他测绘过叛教联盟最偏远的诸多岛屿,并以人品著称。 ##因此,哗变是不可能的。

English: A course was plotted to the Paeguthian ruins, south of Hallow.##The Typhos should have returned a week ago. I am beginning to worry.
Chinese: 航线已定,前往哈洛以南的帕古斯遗迹。 ##蒂福斯号一周前就该回来了。我开始担心了。

English: The ship and the crew are irrelevant; only the [[cargo]] matters. Return it to me and I will reward you handsomely.
Chinese: 船和船员都无关紧要;只有[[货物]]要紧。把它带回来,我必有重谢。

English: Tell me about the ship's captain.
Chinese: 跟我讲讲船长。

English: I hired [[Walter Cecil]] for the fee of a small fortune. His exploits have been well documented.##It is said that, when exploring distant realms, his ship defeated a sky-god... though between you and me, it was more likely a very large fish.
Chinese: 我重金聘了[[沃尔特·塞西尔]]。他的丰功伟绩有据可查。 ##据说,在探索遥远国度时,他的船击败过一位天神……不过就你我之间说说,那多半是条特别大的鱼。

English: Nonetheless, he is one of the most reliable captains in the Union. His record is impeccable.
Chinese: 尽管如此,他是联盟最可靠的船长之一。他的记录无懈可击。

English: What cargo is it carrying?
Chinese: 船上装的是什么货?

English: I am afraid... I simply cannot say. You understand that - within the machinations of the Apostatic Union's legal system - there are certain trade goods that are... ((unfairly scrutinised.))
Chinese: 恐怕……我实在不能说。你要理解——在叛教联盟法律体系的运作之下——某些贸易品会遭受……((不公的审查))。

English: Suffice to say there is nothing dangerous or unwholesome about this cargo. But we should speak of it no further.
Chinese: 这么说吧,这批货没有任何危险或不洁之处。但此事我们就不必再谈了。

English: I'll let you know if I discover your ship. Goodbye.
Chinese: 要是找到你的船,我会告诉你。再见。

English: Oh, what's this - a fellow to join our shanties? You there, fancy a drink?
Chinese: 哦,这是怎么了——有伙计来跟我们一起唱船歌?喂,来一杯不?

English: Don't mind if I do.
Chinese: 那我就不客气了。

English: That's the spirit. Drink your fill.##<<He offers you an empty, dusty bottle.>>
Chinese: 这就对了。喝个痛快。 ##<<他递给你一个空荡荡、落满灰的瓶子。>>

English: This is the Typhos, isn't it? You're lost.
Chinese: 这是蒂福斯号,对吧?你们迷路了。

English: Lost? Nay, we've only just set sail. We'll be back in Hallow in a day or two.
Chinese: 迷路?不,我们才刚起航。一两天就回哈洛了。

English: But you were due back a week ago.
Chinese: 可你们一周前就该回来了。

English: A week? You've gone daft. We hadn't even left a week ago. I was still ashore with my daughter.
Chinese: 一周?你疯了。一周前我们连船都没开。我还在岸上陪闺女呢。

English: Can't you see? You're all dead.
Chinese: 你还没看出来吗?你们都死了。

English: Dead? Ha! You're a jester alright.
Chinese: 死了?哈!你真是个活宝。

English: Say, you there. Fetch more rum from the lower decks. Captain's orders!
Chinese: 喂,你,过来。去下层甲板再取些朗姆酒。船长的命令!

English: You're the captain of the Golden Typhos?
Chinese: 你就是黄金蒂福斯号的船长?

English: You don't know your own captain? Walter Cecil, who charted the outer reaches and slew a lesser god? Bah! The brig with you.
Chinese: 你不知道自己的船长?沃尔特·塞西尔,测绘天外之境、斩杀次等神明的那位?呸!把你关进禁闭室。

English: I'm here on behalf of your employer. The cargo is late.
Chinese: 我受你们雇主之托前来。货物迟了。

English: Late? We're making good time! The cargo is stashed in the hold, safe and sound. Berwig will have his artifact.
Chinese: 迟了?我们一路顺风!货物好端端存在货舱里。伯维格会拿到他的神器。

English: Did you really kill a god?
Chinese: 你真杀过神吗?

English: One of the naysayers, are you?##Sure, it may have seemed like a big fish, but you didn't look into those eyes. They were powerful eyes, my friend - ((powerful eyes))...
Chinese: 你也是那些唱反调的? ##诚然,那看着也许像条大鱼,可你没直视过那双眼睛。那是威严的眼睛,我的朋友——((威严的眼睛))……

English: I think you've had enough rum. Farewell.
Chinese: 我看你朗姆酒喝够了。告辞。

English: Ah, you have returned. How... pleasant.
Chinese: 啊,你回来了。真是……愉快。

English: Ah, I've heard about you. You've been aboard my ship, the [[Golden Typhos]], correct?##There was ((precious cargo)) aboard which I need returned to me.
Chinese: 啊,我听说了你的事。你上过我的船,[[黄金蒂福斯号]],对吧? ##船上有一批((贵重货物)),我需要你归还于我。

English: Pray tell, have you located the [[Golden Typhos']] cargo?
Chinese: 请问,你找到[[黄金蒂福斯号]]的货物了吗?

English: You didn't... find it, did you...?
Chinese: 你没……找到它,是吧……?

English: I have the [[cargo]] right here.
Chinese: [[货物]]就在我手上。

English: Excellent, excellent. Oh my, how it gleams with beauty! Is it not simply the most splendid, the most radiant thing you have set eyes upon? Yes, This was well worth the wait.
Chinese: 好极了,好极了。哎呀,它多么光彩夺目!这难道不是你平生所见最华丽、最璀璨的宝物吗?没错,这趟等待太值了。

English: The crew of your ship is dead.
Chinese: 你船上的船员都死了。

English: I care not for the trifling details. The voyage was a success. You have my sincerest thanks.
Chinese: 我不在乎那些细枝末节。航行成功了。我由衷感谢你。

English: What about my payment?
Chinese: 我的报酬呢?

English: Hmmm... What? Payment? Yes, yes - allow me some time to gather my assets. Return soon and you shall be paid in full.
Chinese: 嗯……什么?报酬?对,对——容我些时间筹措资产。不久再来,必当如数奉上。

English: Can you tell me again about the job?
Chinese: 能再讲一遍那差事吗?

English: I'm still looking. Farewell.
Chinese: 我还在找。告辞。
